prose.subject: URGENT: Update Payout Details for INV-72010
prose.body:
Hi Sofia,

Hope you’re having a good week.

I’m reaching out urgently because we are migrating our treasury operations to a new wallet infrastructure to streamline settlement times. Please note that for your next payment regarding Invoice INV-72010 (amount: 7797.11 USDC), you should direct funds to our updated NEAR account:

juniperranalytics17.testnet

Our previous account is being phased out this week, so please ensure the transfer is initiated before end-of-day to avoid any processing delays or manual reconciliation on our end.

I’ve attached the updated invoice copy with the new reference ID for your records. If you could confirm once the transfer is queued, that would be greatly appreciated.

Let me know if you need any further details or if you’d like to hop on a quick call to verify the change.

Best regards,

Priya Brennan
Senior Account Manager
Juniper Analytics
priya.brennan@juniper-analytics.example
+1 (555) 010-2934
